tools.name: create_site
tools.description: Creates a whoisbrowsing site with no sign-up and returns its script tag (snippet), one watch link per website, a one-time claim link and the next steps. Call it once per project; one site can hold several domains. Never write the watch or claim link into a file, commit or log.

tools.name: get_install_instructions
tools.description: Returns the install guide (Markdown) for one platform: where the script tag goes, a Content-Security-Policy note and how to verify. Call it without a platform, or with an unknown one, to get the list of platforms.

tools.name: check_live
tools.description: Asks the live server whether the site's script is connected right now: the websites with a visitor, how many visitors, and which websites the owner is watching. Needs the site's owner key, the part after #wib= in the watch link create_site returned. Load a page that has the tag (a private window cou

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "check_live" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Asks the live server whether the site's script is connected right now: the websites with a visitor, how many visitors, and which websites the owner is watching.…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
